g.text: - All capacitors in the RF section should be rated for at least 200V and be C0G.

g.desc: - All capacitors in the RF section should be rated for at least 200V and be C0G.

g.text: - Inductors L2-L5 should be wound on Kool Mu 0077932A7 cores using 22AWG or larger magnet wire.

g.desc: - Inductors L2-L5 should be wound on Kool Mu 0077932A7 cores using 22AWG or larger magnet wire.

g.text: - Inductor L2 requires two stacked Kool Mu 0077932A7 cores.

g.desc: - Inductor L2 requires two stacked Kool Mu 0077932A7 cores.

g.text: - Measure inductances at 470Khz on a VNA or 100KHz on a LCR, try to be within 0.2uH.

g.desc: - Measure inductances at 470Khz on a VNA or 100KHz on a LCR, try to be within 0.2uH.

g.text: - L1 sees primarily DC current and is tolerant to variation in indcutance—it can can be purchased pre-wound.

g.desc: - L1 sees primarily DC current and is tolerant to variation in indcutance—it can can be purchased pre-wound.

g.text: A crystal oscillator is required (?) for oscillator stability.

g.desc: A crystal oscillator is required (?) for oscillator stability.

g.text: - 10µF capacitors outside of the RF section can be X5R or X7R.

g.desc: - 10µF capacitors outside of the RF section can be X5R or X7R.

g.text: - 10µF is the capacitance at 0V, under 10µF with voltage applied is acceptable.

g.desc: - 10µF is the capacitance at 0V, under 10µF with voltage applied is acceptable.

g.text: - In order to reduce ringing, place the gate driver output as close to the gate as possible.

g.desc: - In order to reduce ringing, place the gate driver output as close to the gate as possible.

g.text: - Oscillator frequency should be within ±5KHz of 470KHz.

g.desc: - Oscillator frequency should be within ±5KHz of 470KHz.

g.text: - Thermistor is for inrush current limiting

g.desc: - Thermistor is for inrush current limiting

g.text: - May not be needed for some/most DC power supplies.

g.desc: - May not be needed for some/most DC power supplies.

g.text: - Should be rated for at least 5A with a low hot resistance.

g.desc: - Should be rated for at least 5A with a low hot resistance.

g.text: - Replace TH1 with a >6A Schottky diode for reverse protection.

g.desc: - Replace TH1 with a >6A Schottky diode for reverse protection.
